newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies six issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies six issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said it has qualified for bond insurance the following six municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Center Point-Urbana, Iowa, $3.685 million school general obligation bonds.
--Clark County School District, Nev., $300 million of GO bonds.
--Baldwinsville CSD, N.Y., $4 million scholl district bonds.
--Fonda-Fultonville School District, N.Y., $1.8 million of shool district bonds.
--Shawano, Wis., $1.470 million GOs corporate purpose bonds.
